readings.moment: When the temple struck nine at dinner
When Félix took his watch out at dinner, as the temple struck nine
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door
A thump on the floor right above him, in the atelier
Uncle's repeater sounded; the first ten slow deep notes (the hour)
Someone came quickly down the stairs
Bastien Girard came into the library
The temple struck eleven, when Félix and Girard had been sitting together in the library

durations: From 10:15 to 10:21 by Félix's watch: about 6 minutes between someone going up the stairs and someone coming down
From Girard's arrival at 10:32 by Félix's watch until the temple struck eleven at 11:00: about 28 minutes (sitting together in the library; the two endpoints come from different timepieces)
whereabouts: At dinner, the family brought their watches to the table, and Félix had his watch out at the table when the temple struck nine
At dinner, Félix's uncle made a scene about Félix's watch in front of everyone
Girard was at dinner and laughed at Félix's watch
Girard and another party ("they") had quarrelled over the price of the repeater at dinner
After dinner, Félix went up to the library and stayed there alone
In the library, Félix poured himself a brandy, and then another
Rosa was in the hall (a remembered fragment, not timed)
Félix's aunt's piano was playing downstairs during the period before the thump
An unidentified person went quickly up the stairs past the library door at 10:15 by Félix's watch; Félix did not see who it was and the library door was shut
An unidentified person came quickly down the stairs at 10:21 by Félix's watch; Félix did not see who it was
Bastien Girard came into the library at 10:32 by Félix's watch
Félix and Girard sat together in the library until the temple struck eleven
Félix poured Girard a brandy in the library; Girard did not drink it
